'''June 2001 Sheridan tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Sheridan, Wyoming in June 2001. [[Travis Rumans]] won it. It is known from Travis Rumans's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2513">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-24-mt-and-wo-6-22-6-24-triple-trd2513/ mt-and-wo-6-22-6-24-triple-tr], DeckTech (Travis "Com Igar" Rumans, 24 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-24-mt-and-wo-6-22-6-24-triple-trd2513/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 22 June 2001<ref name="tr-d2539" />
* '''Site:''' Sheridan, Wyoming
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Travis Rumans]]
